profile.summary: Alessandroasm is a Mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Chart.js, focusing on core rendering logic, data visualization algorithms, and DOM integration. Their contributions demonstrate deep debugging skills, particularly in handling edge cases like NaN values in chart dimensions and recursive layout calculations. The developer also shows proficiency in CI/CD workflows (Travis CI) and dependency management, with a strong ability to identify and fix subtle bugs in charting libraries. Their work is primarily frontend-focused, with evidence of defensive programming and test-driven development practices.
